title: The Cat That Walked by Herself
text: Long ago, all the animals were wild.
The Woman lived in a cave with the Man.
One day the Dog came to the cave because he wanted to eat.
The Woman gave him a bone, and the Dog became their friend.
Then the Horse and the Cow came, and they became friends too.
The Cat didn't want to be a friend.
She said, "I am the Cat, and I walk by myself."
But at night she sat near the fire, because it was warm.
